min_diff = float('inf')
best_num = 0
best_den = 1
for i in range(1, int(n) + 1):
    val = (x * i) / y
    floor_val = int(val // 1)
    if abs((x / y) - (floor_val / i)) < min_diff:
        min_diff = abs((x / y) - (floor_val / i))
        best_num = floor_val
        best_den = i
    ceil_val = int(-(-val // 1))  # equivalent to ceil for positive numbers
    if abs((x / y) - (ceil_val / i)) < min_diff:
        min_diff = abs((x / y) - (ceil_val / i))
        best_num = ceil_val
        best_den = i
print(f"{best_num}/{best_den}")
